task.description: WF-03 Step 03 (BACKEND-DEV) for GH-752/ISS-0692. Implement the mitigation chosen in step-01/02: (b) primary: add a default -j cap to the test-integration build step in build.zig, env-var-configurable (suggest BPM_TEST_INTEGRATION_J, default e.g. 8); (a) secondary: raise BPM_TEST_STMT_TIMEOUT default from 300s to 600s in tests/integration/helpers.zig runMigrations() and runMigrationsForSchema() (env var override preserved). DO NOT modify tools/lint_test_isolation.baseline.json. DO NOT modify src/event_store/store.zig. DO NOT modify tests/integration/sim01_04_simulation_mode_test.zig (already fixed in sibling run WF03-GH753-20260812). Branch: create feature/WF03-GH752-20260812 from main. Commit message convention: fix(tests): GH-752/ISS-0692 add default -j cap + raise BPM_TEST_STMT_TIMEOUT default. After implementation: zig build must succeed; zig build test must pass; zig build test-integration (full default concurrency, not the new -j cap, to confirm the test itself still works) must complete cleanly without the new -j cap engaged (because we set the env var to a high value during this check).

Pass handoff to TEST-RUNNER (Step 05) for the 5-consecutive-clean-run gate
